caption: The drawing depicts a single mechanical object positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a vertically oriented wooden block with visible grain, rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter streaks that emphasize the texture of the wood. Attached to the top of the block is a metal component featuring a toothed vertical piece with a forked, upward-facing end, colored in a dark gray metallic tone. Affixed to the side of the wooden block is a metal crank handle, also dark gray in color, with a round wooden grip that matches the wood of the main body. The crank mechanism includes a spiked cogwheel or gear, which is partially embedded in the side of the block, aligned with the metal handle. The composition is centered, and there are no other objects present in the image. The background remains unadorned, emphasizing the details and textures of the object.
title: Conestoga Wagon Jack
